dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: More impressive than the insight required to capture the grey-brown fortress's appearance is the admirable patience you've displayed in reconstructing it...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Hold on. Do allow me to look up — I don't suppose this streetlight is broken by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Ah, wonderful. Seeing it shining as brightly as before puts my mind at ease. Were even such fine details painstakingly recreated, my admiration for you might come closer to fear and trembling instead.
